name: Perfect Yeti Hide
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 440 experience instead of 2,200, 0.2 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You have found what may very well be a perfect yeti hide.  You easily note that it is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar.

Considering that Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Perfect Yeti Hide to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is an incredible find! I believe this is the finest yeti hide specimen I have ever seen!Indeed, this is certainly worthy of an appropriate bounty. I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm confident I can make something special from it. Thanks for thinking of me on this, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: What's this, adventurer - you've got something special for me?
